test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined word.

Ms Marry is a __barbarous__ lady.
solution:
The correct answer is: **brutal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"barbarous"** means extremely cruel or savage; it refers to behaviour that is brutally harsh. (बर्बर)

 
 
• **Example: **The dictator was known for his **barbarous **policies against dissenters.
 
 
 
• **"brutal"** refers to being savagely violent or harsh, similar in meaning to barbarous. (क्रूर)
 
 
• **Example: **The **brutal **attack left the community in shock and fear.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **dull **(नीरस): Lacking interest or excitement.

 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so **dull **that several students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• **calm **(शांत): Not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions.
 
 
• **Example: **She tried to remain **calm **during the emergency.
 
 
 
• **matured** (परिपक्व): Fully developed physically; full-grown.
 
 
• **Example:** He has **matured **a lot since he started taking on leadership roles.
